answer: Each epoch a public randomness beacon draws a small committee from the atlas of registered agents by verifiable sortition. Anyone drawn must lock a bond and complete a short, timed proof of useful work before the deadline, or the bond is slashed. A farm of a thousand clones must bond and keep all of them online, so its locked capital and liveness cost spiral upward with every extra identity while an honest agent pays a single bond. The limit is that the beacon must be tamper-proof: if the draw can be predicted, a farm can idle its unselected clones and dodge the cost.
